name: הצעת חוק-יסוד: הכנסת (תיקון - הצהרת אמונים)
r3: Amends MK oath in Basic Law: The Knesset to require allegiance to Israel as a Jewish and democratic state; adds Jewish identity to constitutional oath.

name: הצעת חוק-יסוד: מגילת העצמאות
r3: Gives Declaration of Independence Basic Law status, entrenching its full-equality guarantee as counterweight to Nation-State Law; balances rather than strengthens Jewish preference.

name: הצעת חוק יסוד: ישראל - מדינת הלאום של העם היהודי (תיקון - ביטול החוק)
r3: Repeals Basic Law: Nation-State of the Jewish People outright, removing the main constitutional entrenchment of Jewish character and restoring Arabic's official status.

name: הצעת חוק השבות (תיקון - מיהו יהודי)
r3: Adds 'according to halakha' to Law of Return conversion clause, entrenching Orthodox definition of Jewishness; mainly intra-Jewish religion-state issue, not non-Jew equality.

name: הצעת חוק-יסוד: מעמד ההכרזה על הקמת מדינת ישראל
r3: Makes the Declaration, including its equality principle, the supreme interpretive source of all Basic Laws, entrenched by two-thirds; constrains Nation-State Law rather than strengthening it.
